decisions.title: UI spec §7.4 says the calibrating overlay reads 'Ride in a straight line at a constant speed', but bias zeroing must be stationary and idling. How do we reconcile?
options: Phase-specific instruction copy inside one calibrating state (stationary zero / hard pull / in-ride verify)
Keep the UI spec sentence as the only copy and move bias zeroing out of the calibrating state entirely
Change the UI spec sentence to the stationary instruction
decisions.recommended: Phase-specific instruction copy inside one calibrating state (stationary zero / hard pull / in-ride verify)
decisions.answer: Change the UI spec sentence to the stationary instruction

decisions.title: What does the core Measurement enum get renamed to, given the Foundation collision?
options: Sample (leaves the UI spec's TelemetrySample name free for the display record)
TelemetrySample (forces the UI display record to be renamed instead)
decisions.recommended: Sample (leaves the UI spec's TelemetrySample name free for the display record)
decisions.answer: Sample (leaves the UI spec's TelemetrySample name free for the display record)

decisions.title: How is a WheelieRun persisted relative to the raw NDJSON session log?
options: Derived metrics + intervals + ~30 Hz decimated display series + a reference (session id + time span) into the raw log
Embed the run's raw samples in the run record, duplicating them out of the session log
decisions.recommended: Derived metrics + intervals + ~30 Hz decimated display series + a reference (session id + time span) into the raw log
decisions.answer: Derived metrics + intervals + ~30 Hz decimated display series + a reference (session id + time span) into the raw log

decisions.title: Config.eventExitPitch is currently 4.0 deg but UI spec §7.6 says 5 deg. Which wins?
options: Change Config to 5 deg, add eventEntryDwell/eventExitDwell, bump Config.version to 2
Keep 4 deg and treat the UI spec number as illustrative
decisions.recommended: Change Config to 5 deg, add eventEntryDwell/eventExitDwell, bump Config.version to 2
decisions.answer: Change Config to 5 deg, add eventEntryDwell/eventExitDwell, bump Config.version to 2

decisions.title: R5 (audio/video time alignment) is withdrawn. Does the microphone survive anywhere?
options: Keep the mic for the stationary once-per-bike vibration recording only — it is the only unaliased view of engine frequency
Remove the microphone from the product entirely and drop the RPM-labelled vibration profile
decisions.recommended: Keep the mic for the stationary once-per-bike vibration recording only — it is the only unaliased view of engine frequency
decisions.answer: Keep the mic for the stationary once-per-bike vibration recording only (implied by approving requirements.md as written)

decisions.title: SyntheticSource's gyro sign and gravity x-sign contradict AxisElevation's quaternion convention (verified numerically). Which side moves?
options: Correct SyntheticSource to the AxisElevation/Z-up convention and add a convention-guard test before the ESKF
Adopt the generator's aerospace convention and change AxisElevation plus its passing test
decisions.recommended: Correct SyntheticSource to the AxisElevation/Z-up convention and add a convention-guard test before the ESKF
decisions.answer: Correct SyntheticSource to the AxisElevation/Z-up convention and add a convention-guard test before the ESKF
